title: EverythingPal
shortDescription: Search local files and folders from PowerToys Command Palette with smart case/whitespace matching (term1 finds Term 1), powered by Everything.
description: EverythingPal brings the Everything search index into PowerToys Command Palette. Type part of a file name on the Command Palette home screen for an inline result (pressing Enter opens the full result list), or open the EverythingPal command page for a live ranked list with real shell icons, file size, modified time and full paths. Single-word searches ignore case and spaces (term1 finds Term 1); Everything's advanced syntax (ext:, folder:, wildcards, paths) is passed through unchanged. Requires Everything 1.4/1.5a installed and running; the required es.exe CLI is bundled and no network access is used. Free, open source (MIT), bilingual Chinese/English UI.
